source: Data Dictionary §0.1 (478-point MediaPipe Face Landmarker). VERIFY each index with debug.html before trusting metrics (T-03).
verified_notes: T-04 side-convention self-test PASSED on live GitHub Pages deploy: wink LEFT->L, wink RIGHT->R, raise LEFT corner->L. Blendshape suffixes confirmed subject-relative. Visual index check on debug.html still recommended for full T-03 sign-off.

convention.side: patient anatomical side. L = patient's left = appears on IMAGE RIGHT in an un-mirrored frame. Never screen side.
convention.mirror: preview mirrored for display; all computation un-mirrored (R4.4).

iris_ring.desc: diameter estimate: mean of opposite-pair distances 469-471 & 470-472 (R), 474-476 & 475-477 (L)

inner_lip_polygon.desc: dental-show polygon (S11); split by plane-projected midline into L/R.

headframe_fit.desc: Stable, rarely paretic bilateral pairs + midline points for the midsagittal plane fit (§0.2). Mouth and brow are EXCLUDED (they are the pathology).

blendshapes.desc: MediaPipe Face Landmarker outputs 52 blendshape categories. Names below are the MediaPipe category names. The Left/Right SUFFIX side convention relative to the PATIENT is recorded in side_map. EXPECTED (subject/anatomical-relative: eyeBlinkLeft = subject's own left eye) is pre-filled, but the T-04 self-test (selftest.html) is the authority: it confirms or overrides this and sets verified=true.
blendshapes.side_map_notes: side_map keys map patient anatomical side -> MediaPipe blendshape suffix (lowercase). Expected mapping assumes MediaPipe suffixes are subject-relative. Run selftest.html: wink patient LEFT -> whichever eyeBlink<suffix> dominates is patient_L. If the self-test yields the opposite (viewer-relative) mapping, replace this with { "patient_L": "right", "patient_R": "left" } and set side_map_source to "selftest_verified".
